cases.decision: The three new-game save-slot labels and the managed empty-slot progress indicator use the same feminine agreement for an implied new game; the indicator preserves the source uppercase emphasis.
cases.mapping: Each UI ID keeps its paired build-specific level0 key; display:slot-new replaces the three mapped managed NEW literals per platform. Keep numeric progress formats and greyed-slot templates exact.
cases.positive: Each of the three empty slots has both its label and managed progress value; occupied progress retains the original numeric format.
cases.negative: Reject an unpatched managed occurrence, a changed numeric placeholder or changes to greyed-slot templates.
cases.editorial: author self-reviewed against the source scope and existing menu observation
cases.adapter: existing source-pinned UI and managed slot adapters; source-bound per-build checks below
cases.runtimeVisual: authored labels and occupied-state fit not run

cases.decision: Keep the explicit error marker and identify a missing text line; it remains an exceptional fallback, not ordinary dialogue.
cases.mapping: display:yarn-missing-line replaces both mapped LocalizedLine literals on each platform; unused provider fallback and serialized choice template stay exact.
cases.positive: Both fallback occurrences on each platform receive the same single-line plain text.
cases.negative: Reject a changed provider fallback, inserted rich text or line break, or a source assembly fingerprint mismatch.
cases.editorial: author self-reviewed against the source scope
cases.adapter: existing source-pinned managed fallback adapter; source-bound per-build checks below
